moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio tx-word-highlight-caption, written here): Page of 3–5 words, 30 px weight 800, white with a 4 px dark outline; page fades in 0.15–0.3 s and out 4.15–4.35 s. Word times split 0.4–3.4 s in proportion to word length (stand-in for transcript times). The active word scales 1 → 1.1 about its own centre and lifts 2 px in 80 ms power2.out, turns accent past half way, and returns in 80 ms after its end. Loop 4.6 s. Params: số từ mỗi trang (3–5) · độ phóng (1.1) · thời gian đổi (80 ms).
